wargear.name: Baronial heraldry
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hundred years of victories painted across the faceplate and shoulder carapace, each one a promise to the Household. The Knight fights with the whole court watching and gains +1 Weapon Skill and +1 Ballistic Skill.

wargear.name: Sacristan's reliquary
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A locked casket of sacred oils, coolant-psalters and the ashes of former pilots, kept by a Sacristan who rides in the lee of the war machine. The Knight gains +1 Hull Point (or +1 Wound on an Armiger).

The Armiger Helverin may exchange its Phaeton autocannon for

modifiers.text: Pressed levies who know the Household's justice: +1 LD, -1 CL.

rites.name: The Armiger Ward
rites.flavor: The young scions go first, and the Baron watches from the ridge.
rites.text: Armiger Helverins, Warglaives and Moiraxes may fill Troops slots and cost 15 points less. Every Armiger gains +1 Initiative. The Household's great Knights are held back for the final reckoning: no Acastus Knights, and no more than one Lord of War. At least three Armigers are required.

rites.name: The Lists of Honour
rites.flavor: A Knight who will not name his challenge is only a tank with a coat of arms.
rites.text: Every Knight gains Fear (1) and +1 Weapon Skill. The army will not skulk: no Recon, no Support units and no Acastus Knights. At least one Knight is required.

modifiers.text: The Lists of Honour: Fear (1), +1 WS.

require.note: A Knight must issue the challenge.

rites.name: The Sacristan's Vigil
rites.flavor: Each Knight is carried to war on a ledger of vows, and the ledger is long.
rites.text: Every Knight gains +2 Hull Points. The weight of the rites slows the Household: every Knight loses 2 Movement and costs 30 points more, and no more than two Lords of War may be fielded.

rites.name: Muster of the Free Levy
rites.flavor: The Baron calls his tithe, and every town on his world sends its sons.
rites.text: Infantry Troops and Levy Troops cost 10 points less, Grenadier Troops may fill Troops slots, and the Household's Militia gain +1 Willpower. The Knights are too few to share the glory: at most one Lord of War, and no Armiger Moirax.

modifiers.text: Muster of the Free Levy: +1 WP.
